# 404 sections: Dark

The brand dark green as a full-height background, for standalone pages outside the application shell.

A complete standalone component built only from `@mod-internal/ui`, Angular and plain CSS with the library tokens. Copy it, rename the selector and class, replace the sample text and data with the project's own (and its translation mechanism), and keep the structure.

```ts
import { Location } from '@angular/common';
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { ModButton, ModErrorPage } from '@mod-internal/ui';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-not-found',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  imports: [RouterLink, ModErrorPage, ModButton],
  template: `
    <!-- fullHeight fills the viewport; set --mod-error-min-height on a parent to change it. -->
    <mod-error-page
      dark
      fullHeight
      code="404 error"
      heading="Page not found"
      description="The page you requested is not available. It may have been moved, or the address may be incorrect."
    >
      <a mod-button onColor routerLink="/">Back to home</a>
      <button mod-button variant="secondary-outline" onColor type="button" (click)="back()">Go back</button>
    </mod-error-page>
  `,
})
export class NotFound {
  private readonly location = inject(Location);

  protected back(): void {
    this.location.back();
  }
}
```
